title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 3,301–3,350 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

examples.en: Youth volunteering in remote rural schools enriches both mentors and kids.
examples.zh: 青年學子前往偏鄉部落小學進行課輔志工服務，同時豐富了自身與孩子的心靈。

examples.en: Volunteering at the local animal shelter taught her valuable lessons about responsibility.
examples.zh: 在在地動物收容所進行志工服務讓她學到了關於責任感的寶貴課題。

examples.en: Engaging in corporate volunteering builds strong team camaraderie outside the office.
examples.zh: 參與企業志工服務活動能在辦公室之外建立深厚的團隊情誼。

words.definition: 非營利的；非營利機構 (NPO / NGO)

examples.en: Non-profit foundations provide free nutritious lunches to lonely elders daily.
examples.zh: 諸多在地非營利公益慈善基金會每日為社區獨居長者提供免費熱騰騰的營養午餐。

examples.en: She left her corporate banking job to work for an environmental non-profit organization.
examples.zh: 她辭去了商業銀行的工作，轉而為一家環保非營利機構服務。

examples.en: As a non-profit entity, any surplus funds are reinvested into community projects.
examples.zh: 作為一個非營利組織，任何結餘資金都會全數重新投入社區公益專案中。

words.definition: 慈善機構；施捨；仁愛善舉

examples.en: Generous citizens contributed generously to the winter clothing charity.
examples.zh: 熱心慷慨的廣大市民踴躍響應寒冬送暖慈善機構發起的冬衣禦寒募集活動。

examples.en: The concert proceeds will be donated to a local children's cancer charity.
examples.zh: 這場音樂會的所有演出收益將全數捐贈給在地兒童癌症慈善機構。

examples.en: He believes that true charity begins at home by taking care of loved ones.
examples.zh: 他深信真正的仁愛善舉始於家庭，應從照顧身邊摯愛的家人做起。

examples.en: Corporate philanthropy funded scholarship programs for disadvantaged college students.
examples.zh: 企業熱心推動的公益慈善事業資助了眾多清寒優秀大學生的全額獎學金計畫。

examples.en: The tech billionaire devoted the second half of his life to global health philanthropy.
examples.zh: 這位科技富豪將自己的後半生全心奉獻於全球公共衛生的慈善事業上。

examples.en: Strategic philanthropy focuses on addressing the root causes of systemic poverty.
examples.zh: 策略性慈善著重於從根本上解決造成結構性貧困的深層病因。

examples.en: High-tech executives donate laptops and tablets to rural learning centers.
examples.zh: 竹科科技高階主管大方捐贈全新筆記型電腦與平板給偏鄉數位學習中心。

examples.en: Many compassionate citizens choose to donate blood every three months.
examples.zh: 許多富有愛心的熱血民眾選擇每三個月定期挽袖捐血一次。

examples.en: You can donate gently used books and toys to the community library.
examples.zh: 你可以把保存良好的二手書本與玩具捐贈給社區圖書館。

examples.en: All monetary donations receive official tax-deductible electronic receipts.
examples.zh: 每筆愛心捐款皆會即刻開立具備合法抵稅效力的正式電子捐款收據。

examples.en: The museum was built largely through generous private donations from alumni.
examples.zh: 這座博物館主要依靠歷屆校友慷慨解囊的民間善款捐贈興建而成。

examples.en: Even a small recurring donation of ten dollars a month helps save lives.
examples.zh: 即便是每個月十美元的小額定期定額捐款，也能發揮拯救生命的龐大力量。

examples.en: The online crowdfunding charity campaign raised two million dollars in a week.
examples.zh: 這場線上公益群眾募資專案在短短一週之內便成功籌得了逾兩百萬元的善款。

examples.en: Students baked cookies and cupcakes for the school library fundraising drive.
examples.zh: 學生們親手烘烤了手工餅乾與杯子蛋糕，為學校圖書館的籌款活動出力。

examples.en: Successful fundraising depends on compelling storytelling that moves donors' hearts.
examples.zh: 成功的公益募款活動仰賴能深深打動捐款人心靈的動人真實故事。

examples.en: Celebrities and philanthropists gathered at the annual charity gala for medical research.
examples.zh: 各界影視名流與大慈善家齊聚年度慈善晚宴，攜手為罕見疾病醫學研究籌募經費。

examples.en: Guests dressed in glamorous evening gowns and tuxedos for the museum's opening gala.
examples.zh: 賓客們身著華美晚禮服與筆挺燕尾服出席博物館的開幕盛大慶祝晚宴。

examples.en: The charity gala raised hundreds of thousands of dollars through an exciting live auction.
examples.zh: 這場慈善晚會透過扣人心弦的現場愛心拍賣籌募了數十萬美元的善款。

words.definition: 食物銀行；食物物資庫存中心

examples.en: Community food banks distribute rice, canned food, and cooking oil to families.
examples.zh: 在地社區食物銀行每週定期向邊緣弱勢家庭分發愛心白米、罐頭與食用油。

examples.en: Supermarkets partner with the food bank to minimize food waste by donating surplus bread.
examples.zh: 超市連鎖店與食物銀行攜手合作，透過捐贈當日即期麵包來減少食物浪費。

examples.en: Volunteers packaged thousands of holiday meal boxes at the regional food bank.
examples.zh: 志工們在地區食物銀行裡齊心打包了數千份溫馨的節慶愛心食物箱。

words.definition: 愛心共餐廚房；免費施粥所

examples.en: Volunteers chop fresh vegetables early in the morning at the church soup kitchen.
examples.zh: 愛心志工大清早便在教會開辦的愛心共餐廚房裡忙著清洗切削新鮮時蔬備料。

examples.en: During the cold winter storm, the downtown soup kitchen served hundreds of hot meals.
examples.zh: 在寒冬暴風雪肆虐期間，市中心的愛心廚房提供了數百份熱氣騰騰的愛心餐點。

examples.en: Working at a soup kitchen taught him deep humility and gratitude for everyday blessings.
examples.zh: 在愛心廚房擔任義工讓他體會到了深刻的謙卑，並更加感恩日常所擁有的一切。

examples.en: Universities host campus blood drives to replenish critical hospital blood banks.
examples.zh: 大學校園定期熱烈舉辦校園捐血活動，及時為各大醫院補充告急的醫療血庫。

examples.en: A mobile blood drive bus parked outside the city hall attracted dozens of willing donors.
examples.zh: 一輛巡迴捐血車停靠在市政府廣場前，吸引了數十位熱心的市民踴躍挽袖。

examples.en: Donating during a community blood drive is a simple way to directly save someone's life.
examples.zh: 參與社區捐血活動是一種最直接、最純粹能拯救寶貴性命的善舉。

words.definition: 無家可歸的；街友；無家者

examples.en: Winter emergency shelters open their doors to keep homeless citizens warm and safe.
examples.zh: 寒冬避寒庇護所全面敞開大門，確保露宿街頭的無家者街友獲得溫暖與安頓。

examples.en: The city launched a housing-first initiative to help chronic homeless individuals rebuild stability.
examples.zh: 該市推出了「住房優先」輔導計畫，協助長年無家可歸者重新找回生活的安穩。

examples.en: Charities distributed warm fleece sleeping bags to the homeless sleeping in the park.
examples.zh: 慈善團體向露宿在公園的街友們分發了保暖的刷毛防寒睡袋。

examples.en: The foundation provides free music lessons to underprivileged youth.
examples.zh: 該文教基金會為經濟弱勢家庭的青年學子提供完全免費的一對一專業樂器課程。

examples.en: Educational technology initiatives bridge the digital divide for underprivileged students.
examples.zh: 數位教育推廣計畫有效消弭了弱勢家庭學童在科技學習資源上的數位落差。

examples.en: Doctors volunteered in underprivileged communities that lack access to modern clinics.
examples.zh: 醫師們自發前往缺乏現代化診所醫療資源的偏鄉貧困社區進行義務巡迴義診。

examples.en: Social welfare programs aim to protect marginalized groups from extreme poverty.
examples.zh: 健全的社會福利扶助政策旨在保障社會邊緣弱勢群體免於陷入赤貧與飢餓。

examples.en: Human rights organizations fight to give marginalized populations an equal political voice.
examples.zh: 人權倡議團體全力奮戰，旨在讓被社會邊緣化的族群享有平等的政治發聲管道。

examples.en: Children from marginalized backgrounds often face multiple barriers to higher education.
examples.zh: 來自邊緣化弱勢家庭背景的孩子在追求高等教育時往往面臨重重的現實屏障。

examples.en: College clubs organize weekend fun fairs for children living in the local orphanage.
examples.zh: 大學服務性社團在週末為育幼院的孩子們精心策劃了一場歡樂的愛心園遊會。

examples.en: The couple completed the adoption paperwork and welcomed a child from the orphanage.
examples.zh: 這對夫婦順利辦妥了領養法律手續，欣喜地從育幼院接回了心愛的孩子。

examples.en: Donors contributed books and playground equipment to enhance the orphanage's facilities.
examples.zh: 各界善心人士踴躍捐贈課外讀物與遊戲遊樂設施，充實育幼院的育樂硬體環境。

words.definition: 護理之家；安養長照機構

examples.en: High-standard nursing homes provide round-the-clock professional medical and physical care.
examples.zh: 評鑑優良的優質護理之家為失能與高齡長輩提供二十四小時專業醫療照護。

examples.en: Grandfather enjoys playing chess with his fellow residents at the sunny nursing home.
examples.zh: 祖父在採光充足的安養護理之家裡，每天開心地與其他住民爺爺們下棋切磋。

examples.en: Therapy dogs visit local nursing homes every month to bring joy to lonely seniors.
examples.zh: 狗醫生治療犬每月定期前往在地養老院探視，為孤寂的銀髮長輩帶來歡笑與慰藉。

examples.en: Public buses are equipped with low-floor ramps for riders with disabilities.
examples.zh: 市區低底盤電動公車全面配備有無障礙電動斜坡板，方便身心障礙朋友乘車。

examples.en: The law strictly prohibits workplace discrimination based on physical or mental disability.
examples.zh: 法律明文嚴禁任何因生理或心理身心障礙而產生的不公平職場就業歧視。

examples.en: Advancements in prosthetic technology have empowered athletes with disabilities to compete globally.
examples.zh: 先進智慧義肢科技的飛躍進步使身障運動選手能自豪站上國際帕運舞台競賽。

words.definition: 無障礙的；易於使用的；可到達的

examples.en: Modern metro stations are completely wheelchair accessible with tactile floor paving.
examples.zh: 現代捷運站體全面規劃完善的輪椅無障礙動線、導盲磚與大容量博愛無障礙電梯。

examples.en: Web developers must design sites that are accessible to users with vision impairments.
examples.zh: 網頁前端工程師必須打造具備高對比與無障礙網頁規格的網站供視障者使用。

examples.en: The newly renovated museum features wide, accessible ramps and braille descriptions.
examples.zh: 重新整建完工的博物館增設了寬敞好走的無障礙斜坡道與點字導覽說明牌。

examples.en: Certified guide dogs are legally welcomed on public transit and inside eateries.
examples.zh: 通過專業受訓認證的導盲犬受法律保障，可自由進出大眾運輸與各類餐飲場所。

examples.en: Remember never to pet, feed, or distract a working guide dog wearing its harness.
examples.zh: 切記千萬不要隨意撫摸、餵食或呼喊佩戴導盲鞍正在專注執勤的合格導盲犬。

examples.en: Her loyal Labrador guide dog guided her safely across busy multi-lane city streets.
examples.zh: 她忠心耿耿的拉布拉多導盲犬陪伴引導她安全無虞地穿越繁忙的大馬路十字路口。

examples.en: Certified sign language interpreters accompany government press conferences live.
examples.zh: 官方電視直播記者會現場皆配置專業認證的手語翻譯員進行即時手語翻譯。

examples.en: She enrolled in a weekend evening course to learn conversational Taiwanese Sign Language.
examples.zh: 她報名參加了週末夜間研習班，認真學習日常生活實用的台灣手語溝通技巧。

examples.en: Sign language allows the deaf and hard-of-hearing community to communicate with nuance.
examples.zh: 手語讓聽損者與聾人族群能生動、細膩且精準地傳遞複雜豐富的情感與思維。

examples.en: Compassionate social workers visit struggling single-parent households weekly.
examples.zh: 富有同理心與耐心的專業社工師每週定期訪視關懷經濟困難的單親家庭。

examples.en: The certified social worker helped the victim apply for emergency protective orders.
examples.zh: 專業合格社工師及時協助家暴受害者向法院申請緊急民事保護令以策安全。

examples.en: Hospitals employ social workers to assist discharged patients with long-term care plans.
examples.zh: 醫療院所配置專業醫務社工，協助即將出院的病友媒合與規劃長照出院照護計畫。

words.definition: 社會企業（兼顧獲利與社會目的）

examples.en: The bakery operates as a social enterprise, hiring and training young people with autism.
examples.zh: 這家手工烘焙坊作為一家社會企業營運，專門聘僱並培訓自閉症青年自立更生。

examples.en: Social enterprises balance financial sustainability with solving environmental or social problems.
examples.zh: 社會企業在追求商業財務自給自足的同時，肩負著解決環境或社會痛點的使命。

examples.en: This social enterprise produces reusable cloth bags from recycled coastal marine plastic.
examples.zh: 這家綠色社會企業利用回收海洋廢棄寶特瓶塑料，精心縫製耐用的環保手提布包。

words.definition: 社會影響力；正面社會效應

examples.en: Impact investors support startups that generate positive measurable social impact.
examples.zh: 影響力投資人積極注資那些能為弱勢與環境創造可衡量正面社會影響力的新創。

examples.en: The company evaluates success not just by revenue, but by its overall social impact.
examples.zh: 該公司衡量成功的維度不僅看營業額數字，更看重其為在地帶來的整體社會影響力。

examples.en: Youth volunteers achieved lasting social impact by teaching coding to rural teenagers.
examples.zh: 青年志工們透過利用課餘遠距教導偏鄉青少年寫程式，創造了深遠的正面社會效應。

words.definition: 人道主義的；人道救援者

examples.en: Taiwan dispatched medical teams and humanitarian supplies to international earthquake zones.
examples.zh: 台灣第一時間緊急派遣國際搜救醫療隊並空運人道救援物資馳援海外強震災區。

examples.en: The United Nations arranged safe humanitarian corridors for civilians fleeing the conflict.
examples.zh: 聯合國積極斡旋協調開闢安全人道走廊，供逃離戰火衝突的平民老弱婦孺撤離。

examples.en: Dedicating his medical career to treating refugees made him a respected global humanitarian.
examples.zh: 將個人行醫生涯全心奉獻於救治無家可歸的各國難民，使他成為受人景仰的人道主義者。

examples.en: The government established a dedicated emergency disaster relief fund.
examples.zh: 行政院第一時間火速提撥專款成立特別賑災救助專戶，全方位協助災民重建生活。

examples.en: NGOs mobilized thousands of volunteers to deliver food, blankets, and water for disaster relief.
examples.zh: 各大公益組織動員數千名志工投入前線賑災，及時配送熱食、保暖毛毯與飲用水。

examples.en: Efficient coordination among logistics agencies is critical for successful disaster relief.
examples.zh: 各民間救災與物流單位之間高效緊密的協調合作，是災後緊急救援成功的關鍵樞紐。

words.definition: 紅十字會（國際人道救援組織）

examples.en: The Red Cross Society delivers emergency first aid training to high school students.
examples.zh: 中華民國紅十字會長期走入高中校園推廣 CPR+AED 緊急急救救護專業訓練。

examples.en: The International Red Cross remains neutral to deliver life-saving aid across war zones.
examples.zh: 國際紅十字會始終嚴格秉持人道中立立場，跨越戰線烽火為戰區平民運送救命物資。

examples.en: Dedicated Red Cross volunteers distributed hygiene kits to displaced flood survivors.
examples.zh: 熱心敬業的紅十字會志工向因洪患流離失所的受災居民發放急需的個人衛生防疫包。

words.definition: 救援收容中心；中途之家

examples.en: Abandoned puppies received medical checkups at the dedicated animal rescue center.
examples.zh: 遭棄養的幼犬在專業動保救援收容中心裡接受了妥善的醫療除蟲與健康檢查。

examples.en: Marine biologists rehabilitated the stranded sea turtle at the coastal rescue center.
examples.zh: 海洋生物學家在海濱野生動物救援中心裡細心照護並治療擱淺受傷的保育類綠蠵龜。

examples.en: Families interested in pet adoption are warmly welcomed to tour the cat rescue center.
examples.zh: 誠摯歡迎有意以領養代替購買的家庭前來貓咪救援收容中心參觀並互動認養。

words.definition: 流浪的；走失的；流浪動物

examples.en: Advocates promote TNR (Trap-Neuter-Return) programs to manage stray cat populations.
examples.zh: 動保志工團體積極推廣街貓 TNR（誘捕、結紮、原地回置）以友善管理流浪動物。

examples.en: A stray dog that wandered into the school campus was adopted as the school mascot.
examples.zh: 一隻流浪走進國小校園的米克斯流浪狗被全校師生愛心收養，成為深受喜愛的校犬。

examples.en: The shelter rehabilitates injured stray animals and prepares them for loving adoption.
examples.zh: 這座動物收容中途之家細心治療受傷的流浪毛孩，陪伴牠們做好被認養的準備。

examples.en: Loving families foster rescue kittens until permanent adoptive homes are found.
examples.zh: 充滿愛心的中途寄養家庭悉心照顧救援奶貓，直到為牠們找到永遠溫暖的收養家庭。

examples.en: Supportive team environments foster creativity and spark innovative ideas.
examples.zh: 包容且互助的團隊氛圍能大力孕育培養成員的創造力，並激盪出創新的點子。

examples.en: Foster parents provide vulnerable children with stable emotional support during crises.
examples.zh: 充滿大愛的寄養家庭父母在危機時刻為無依弱勢孩童提供了穩定溫暖的情感支柱。

words.definition: 外展服務；深入基層社區關懷

examples.en: Mobile medical clinics conduct healthcare outreach across mountainous villages.
examples.zh: 巡迴偏鄉行動醫療車深入中央山脈偏遠部落，落實第一線基層衛教與醫療外展。

examples.en: The university library expanded its digital outreach to senior citizens in the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 大學圖書館擴大了其針對鄰近社區銀髮銀髮長者的數位生活輔導外展服務。

examples.en: Street outreach teams connect with youth at risk to offer vocational training counseling.
examples.zh: 街頭社工外展小隊走入街角與迷惘的高關懷青少年建立連結，提供職訓生涯輔導。

words.definition: 免費公益的；義務法律諮詢的

examples.en: Prominent law firms provide pro bono legal counsel to low-income clients.
examples.zh: 知名大型律師事務所定期指派資深合夥律師為低收入弱勢族群提供免費公益法律諮詢。

examples.en: The senior architect took on the disaster community rebuilding project completely pro bono.
examples.zh: 這位資深建築師以完全不收費的義務公益形式，主動接下災後社區重建規劃專案。

examples.en: Many professional associations require members to perform annual pro bono service.
examples.zh: 許多專業公會制度化鼓勵會員每年投入一定時數的義務公益專業服務回饋社會。

words.definition: 導師指導制度；引導傳承

examples.en: Industry executives offered one-on-one mentorship to aspiring first-generation college grads.
examples.zh: 業界高階主管為第一代就讀大學的弱勢清寒學子提供一對一的人生職涯導師輔導。

examples.en: Good mentorship guides young professionals through complex workplace dynamics.
examples.zh: 優良的職場導師制度能引領初入職場的新鮮人從容應對複雜的職場人際與技能挑戰。

examples.en: The incubator pairs startup founders with seasoned mentors through its mentorship initiative.
examples.zh: 這家創業孵化育成中心透過其導師制度專案，為新創創辦人媒合經驗豐富的創業前輩。

examples.en: Volunteer tutoring helps disadvantaged elementary students catch up in mathematics.
examples.zh: 大學生志工利用課餘時間進行愛心課後輔導，陪伴弱勢學童奠定扎實的數學基礎。

examples.en: After-school tutoring programs provide struggling readers with targeted literacy practice.
examples.zh: 放學後的課後輔導加強班為閱讀有困難的孩子提供量身打造的識字循序練習。

examples.en: Online peer tutoring gained popularity as a convenient way to study foreign languages.
examples.zh: 線上同儕互助課業輔導作為一種極其便利的語言學習交流管道，日益受到歡迎。

examples.en: The environmental NGO secured a government research grant to protect coral reefs.
examples.zh: 該環保非政府組織成功獲得海洋保育署專案補助款，用於墾丁珊瑚礁生態復育。

examples.en: The university awarded a research grant to the biology laboratory studying renewable biofuels.
examples.zh: 校方為專門研發再生生質燃料的生物實驗室頒發了一筆豐厚的專案科研補助金。

examples.en: The immigration officer reviewed the visa documents carefully before deciding to grant entry.
examples.zh: 移民官在仔細逐一查核所有入境簽證文件無誤後，正式核准外籍旅客入境許可。

examples.en: Low-income families receive monthly rent subsidies from the local government.
examples.zh: 經濟弱勢租屋家庭每月皆可向地方政府領取中央擴大租金補貼減輕居住負擔。

examples.en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs provides solar panel subsidies for rooftop installations.
examples.zh: 經濟部針對民眾在自家住宅屋頂裝設太陽能光電發電板提供優厚專案補助津貼。

examples.en: Agricultural subsidies help local fruit farmers withstand unexpected crop losses from storms.
examples.zh: 政府提撥的農業天然災害救助補助金，有效協助在地果農抵禦颱風帶來的農損衝擊。

examples.en: Civil groups advocate for stronger pedestrian safety legislation and road redesigns.
examples.zh: 民間公民團體大力倡導並推動改善行人地獄現狀、促成更嚴謹的交通安全立法。

examples.en: She has been a fierce advocate for children's mental healthcare resources for decades.
examples.zh: 數十年來，她始終是為兒童心理醫療資源大聲疾呼並積極爭取權益的堅定倡議者。

examples.en: Nutritionists advocate eating balanced whole foods rather than relying entirely on supplements.
examples.zh: 營養專家大力倡導日常應當攝取均衡天然原型食物，而非盲目依賴人工營養補充品。

words.definition: 公益宣導運動；倡議活動；競選

examples.en: The public health campaign raised widespread awareness about mental wellness.
examples.zh: 這場全台公共衛生心理健康公益宣導運動大幅提升了國人對心理諮商的正面認知。

examples.en: The marketing team launched an advertising campaign to showcase new energy-efficient appliances.
examples.zh: 行銷企劃團隊展開了大規模宣傳行銷戰，展示旗下全新一代節能環保家用電器。

examples.en: Volunteers distributed flyers and knocked on doors during the parliamentary election campaign.
examples.zh: 在國會立委選舉競選期間，青年志工們挨家挨戶拜訪發放競選政策文宣。

examples.en: Thousands signed an online petition demanding the protection of pristine wetlands.
examples.zh: 數萬名熱心公民在公共政策網路參與平台上踴躍連署請願，要求劃定珍貴濕地保護區。

examples.en: Neighborhood residents organized a petition urging the city to install a pedestrian traffic light.
examples.zh: 社區周邊住戶發起公民連署請願，強烈敦促市府交通局在盲彎路口增設行人號誌燈。

examples.en: The human rights coalition will petition the international court to investigate war crimes.
examples.zh: 國際人權聯盟將正式向國際法庭遞交請願書，要求徹底調查戰區的反人道罪行。

words.definition: 和平示威遊行；實機示範操作

examples.en: Citizens organized a peaceful demonstration to advocate for gender equality.
examples.zh: 廣大公民走上凱達格蘭大道舉行和平示威倡議遊行，齊心呼籲落實性別實質平等。

examples.en: The robotics instructor gave a live demonstration of how the robotic arm sorts components.
examples.zh: 機器人學教師在課堂上進行現場實機示範操作，展示機械手臂如何自動分揀零件。

examples.en: A large demonstration gathered in the capital square calling for urgent climate action.
examples.zh: 首都廣場上聚集了數萬名群眾舉行盛大示威集會，齊聲要求政府採取氣候變遷因應行動。

words.definition: 草根基層的；由下而上的在地運動

examples.en: The organic farming revolution began as a small grassroots movement among local farmers.
examples.zh: 台灣友善有機農耕的風潮最初源自於一群在地小農由下而上自發推動的草根運動。

examples.en: The political candidate built her campaign through vibrant grassroots community support.
examples.zh: 這位政治候選人憑藉深耕基層、扎實接地氣的草根鄉親熱情支持展開競選。

examples.en: Real lasting social change often springs from persistent grassroots activism at the local level.
examples.zh: 真正深遠長久的社會變革，往往孕育發軔於地方基層公民持之以恆的草根倡議運動。

examples.en: Voting thoughtfully in democratic elections is an essential civic duty.
examples.zh: 在民主自由選舉中秉持理性投下神聖的一票，是每一位現代國民不可推卸的公民責任。

examples.en: Serving on a jury when called is considered an important civic duty in the legal system.
examples.zh: 當接獲法院傳票出任國民法官陪審團時，被視為履行一項極為神聖的公民義務。

examples.en: Responsible citizens fulfill their civic duty by sorting garbage and recycling diligently.
examples.zh: 具備良好素養的現代市民藉由認真做好垃圾分類與資源回收，來體現日常公民責任。

examples.en: Simple good deeds, like giving up your seat on the bus, brighten someone's day.
examples.zh: 舉手之勞的小小日常善行，例如在公車捷運上主動禮讓博愛座，能溫暖他人一整天。

examples.en: The homeowner kept the official property deed safely locked inside the fireproof safe.
examples.zh: 屋主將房屋土地產權所有權狀所有證明地契，妥善存放在防火保險箱中鎖好。

examples.en: He was recognized by the community association for heroic deeds during the river flood rescue.
examples.zh: 他因在溪水暴漲洪患救援行動中奮不顧身英勇救人的義舉，榮獲社區管委會公開表揚。

words.definition: 善意；親善友好；企業商譽

examples.en: The cultural exchange festival fostered immense international goodwill and friendship.
examples.zh: 這場多元文化藝術交流嘉年華在各國青年之間搭起了滿滿的跨國善意與真摯友誼。

examples.en: The diplomat presented traditional Taiwanese tea as a sincere gesture of international goodwill.
examples.zh: 外交官特地致贈頂級台灣高山烏龍茶禮盒，作為展現兩國深厚邦誼的誠摯善意姿態。

examples.en: Decades of outstanding honest service generated enormous commercial goodwill for the bakery.
examples.zh: 數十年來如一日童叟無欺的誠信經營，為這家百年老烘焙坊累積了無比珍貴的商譽資產。

words.definition: 多元共融的；包容的；包含全部的

examples.en: Building an inclusive workplace welcomes talents regardless of physical abilities.
examples.zh: 打造兼具多元、平等與共融（DEI）的友善職場環境，熱情接納不同背景的優秀人才。

examples.en: The resort offered an all-inclusive holiday package covering lodging, dining, and activities.
examples.zh: 這座海濱渡假村推出了一價全包式度假套裝行程，涵蓋了客房住宿、三餐精緻美饌與活動。

examples.en: An inclusive educational curriculum ensures that students of all backgrounds feel valued.
examples.zh: 兼具多元包容性的學校課程規劃，能確保讓來自各種多元文化背景的學生都感受到被尊重。

examples.en: Microloan programs contribute significantly to global poverty alleviation efforts.
examples.zh: 鄉村小額信貸扶貧計畫在推動全球貧窮緩解與消除飢餓方面扮演了極具關鍵的貢獻。

examples.en: The physical therapy clinic specializes in the pain alleviation of chronic back injuries.
examples.zh: 這間專業物理治療所專門致力於協助患者減輕與緩解長年慢性背部運動傷害的頑疾。

examples.en: Building new drainage culverts is necessary for the alleviation of local seasonal flooding.
examples.zh: 疏濬並增建雨水下水道大型箱涵，對於徹底緩解該地區梅雨季節的淹水災情至關重要。

words.definition: 微型金融；小額信貸扶貧

examples.en: Microfinance enables rural female artisans to start small craft cooperatives.
examples.zh: 微型金融為偏鄉女性傳統手工藝人提供了小額創業啟動基金，協助她們成立合作社。

examples.en: Muhammad Yunus pioneered modern microfinance through Bangladesh's famous Grameen Bank.
examples.zh: 穆罕默德·尤努斯透過孟加拉舉世聞名的鄉村銀行，開創了現代微型金融小額信貸的先河。

examples.en: Providing accessible microfinance empowers impoverished families to break the poverty cycle.
examples.zh: 提供免抵押的友善微型金融服務，賦予了許多貧困家庭打破代際貧窮惡性循環的能力。

examples.en: Purchasing fair trade coffee guarantees fair wages for smallholder farmers.
examples.zh: 選購具有公平貿易認證的有機精品咖啡豆，能切實保障產地小農獲得合理的勞動報酬。

examples.en: Consumers can look for the green and blue fair trade certified logo on cocoa products.
examples.zh: 消費者在採購巧克力與可可製品時，可認明包裝上的藍綠雙色公平貿易認證標章。

examples.en: The university campus store pledged to sell exclusively fair trade tea and chocolate.
examples.zh: 這所大學的校園福利社公開宣誓，將全面專營並販售符合公平貿易規範的茶葉與巧克力。

words.definition: 消費主義；消費者權益保護

examples.en: Conscious consumerism encourages buying eco-friendly, locally made products.
examples.zh: 覺醒的道德綠色消費主義鼓勵大家多選購環保減碳且支持在地小農的優質產品。

examples.en: Critics argue that rampant consumerism during holiday shopping sprees generates huge waste.
examples.zh: 評論家指出，節慶購物狂歡節背後失控氾濫的過度消費主義製造了巨量的資源浪費。

examples.en: Ethical consumerism motivates shoppers to boycott brands that exploit overseas factory labor.
examples.zh: 具備社會意識的道德消費主義激勵廣大消費者抵制那些殘酷剝削海外代工勞工的不良品牌。

examples.en: The city mayor hosted a volunteer appreciation banquet to thank dedicated citizens.
examples.zh: 市長特別設宴舉辦模範志工表揚與感恩大會，由衷感謝長年在各角落默默付出的市民。

examples.en: Taking an art history class broadened her critical appreciation of European oil paintings.
examples.zh: 修讀西洋藝術史通識課程大幅拓寬了她對歐洲文藝復興經典油畫的鑑賞鑑賞品味。

examples.en: Property appreciation in growing tech hubs generated significant wealth for early homeowners.
examples.zh: 新興科技園區周邊房地產的強勁增值升值，為早期購屋的在地屋主創造了可觀的財富。

words.definition: 漣漪效應；連鎖正面反應

examples.en: One small act of kindness creates an inspiring ripple effect across society.
examples.zh: 一個看似微不足道的發自內心的善意舉動，能在整個社會激盪起溫暖動人的漣漪效應。

examples.en: The collapse of the investment bank caused a disastrous financial ripple effect worldwide.
examples.zh: 該大型投資銀行的突然崩潰倒閉，在整個全球金融體系中引發了災難性的連鎖骨牌效應。

examples.en: Educating girls produces a powerful multi-generational ripple effect for developing communities.
examples.zh: 為偏鄉發展中小女孩提供平等的受教權，能為整個在地社區孕育深遠的跨世代正面漣漪效應。
